description: This Java source file defines a command handler class for undoing GLIM (Group Ledger-based Microfinance) loan disbursal operations within the Fineract platform. It uses Spring annotations to specify service nature and transaction management, and implements a method to process the undo disbursal command via a platform service.

classes.name: UndoGLIMLoanDisbursalCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class implementing a command handler for undoing GLIM loan disbursal operations, leveraging transaction management and dependency injection to invoke the platform service for processing the command.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the undo GLIM loan disbursal command by delegating to the LoanWritePlatformService and returning the result.
